mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% YoY signals inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals strong economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY is below 2%, the real interest rate is high, signaling a tight monetary policy and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL YoY < 2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS decreases > 100,000 in 1 month and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY > 10% and RSAFS YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances, or if Rank IC for this signal is below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.
